title: Grateful Dead Live at Oakland Auditorium on 1982-12-26
lineage: Cassette Master (Tascam 122mkII) -> Apogee MiniMe (24bit/48k) -> Samplitude Professional v8.01 -> FLAC/16
taper: Cassettes provided by Joani Walker and Paul Scotton

ai_review.summary: Decent audience tape of the 12/26/82 show that starts strong but loses focus later.
ai_review.review: The recording, captured by Joani with an MSC source, is an average‑quality audience tap that sounds fine at the outset. The concert opens energetically but the band rushes the China Cat Sunflower > I Know You Rider segue, making the second half feel a bit sloppy. Overall it’s a modest performance worth hearing for Deadheads interested in this era.

ai_rating.rationale: Reviews are split between praise for the show's start and criticism of its later looseness; no concrete recording‑quality comments, leading to an average combined rating.

recording_quality.technical_notes: No explicit remarks on clarity or mix; reviewers note the tape starts great but later feels sloppy, implying a generally acceptable but not outstanding audio capture.

poor_songs: China Cat Sunflower > I Know You Rider
show_quality.setlist_flow: Strong opening that settles into a longer, less focused middle section; the band appears to rush certain transitions.
